# `/sod-violations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /sod-violations/v1/predict

`startPredictSodViolationsV1` — Predict sod violations for identity.

This API is used to check if granting some additional accesses (entitlements, access profiles, or roles) would cause the subject to be in violation of any SOD policies. Returns the violations that would be caused.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): identitywithnewaccess
- Returns 200: violationprediction

### POST /sod-violations/v1/check

`startViolationCheckV1` — Check sod violations

This API initiates a SOD policy verification asynchronously.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): identitywithnewaccess
- Returns 202: sodviolationcheck
